title: NSTS Bancorp, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: NSTS Bancorp, Inc., a small bank holding company based in Waukegan, Illinois (NASDAQ: NSTS), filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026 announcing the passing of Nathan E. Walker, Executive Vice President and CEO/President of its bank subsidiary North Shore Trust and Savings. Stephen G. Lear, already President and CEO of the holding company, was appointed to also serve as CEO and President of the Bank.
key_points: Nathan E. Walker, EVP and CEO/President of North Shore Trust and Savings, passed away on April 4, 2026
Stephen G. Lear appointed CEO and President of the Bank on April 9, 2026, in addition to his existing role as President and CEO of the holding company
Lear previously served as CEO of the Bank from 1997 to 2022 before Walker succeeded him
There is no change to Lear's compensation arrangements as a result of this appointment
Company is a smaller regional bank (NASDAQ Capital Market listed)
